subject: crtf-prog
title: CRTF.PROG.------TR.
description: First of two diagrams in BK(NM)-6. The prose immediately below identifies the section's structural target: 'By cross-transfer implications of western art music I am referring to how the progressional solidification of the "actual" music comes about. For history can be viewed with respect to how the spread of given concepts — and practices — were brought about.' The crossing diagrams how cross-transfer-progressionalism structurally meets transformation at the cross-transfer-of-progressional-solidification scale: CRTF-PROG (cross-transfer progressionalism) crossed with TR (transformation — the partner-axis's working transformation). CRTF-PROG sits centrally with the subject-arrow; TR sits at top-right at the end of the main line. TRS (transition) branches from the main line to the right margin, with PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) branching from TRS, POL-DY (political dynamics) from PROG-CONT, and SOC-RT (social reality) from POL-DY. PRI-INFO (principle information) branches from the main line to the upper-left, with IST-F (isolated focus) and PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics) branching from it and RE-ST (restructuralism) from PROJ-DY. EXPN (expansion) drops from the main line to the bottom-center, with LK-IMP (linkage implications) branching from it and MOT-DY from LK-IMP.
